title: Notch-cut play
idea: The two cuts that make the bookmark's tail, folded to point forward, make the play: its slanted edges run parallel to the notch's and are just as long, so the hole and the tail look cut by the same hand. The play rests on the tail with an even strap of paper along the notch, and its angle is also the angle of the play button inside the app.
built: Bookmark as p1: 42.5 dp wide, today's proportions, drawn box centred. The play is the notch's triangle folded: its flat side is twice the notch's depth (22 units of 34, 27.5 dp) and its depth half the bookmark's width (17 units, 21.25 dp), so both slanted edges have the notch's slope (32.9 degrees) and length (20.25 units), and the hole has the notch's area. The prototype's Lucide play (polygon 6 3, 20 12, 6 21) slopes at 32.7 degrees, so it is the same shape. Corners r 1.5 units (1.9 dp), the tail tips' radius, because the play's back corners have the tips' 57 degree angle. The flat side sits 0.46 of the depth left of the centre line, leaving 9.2 units of paper at the flat side and 9.1 at the tip. The lower edge is set 5 units square to the notch's left edge: a strap thinner than the 9.2 to 9.4 units at the flat side, tip and top, so the play reads as resting on the tail. The hole is 14.8% of the bookmark.
small: Each cut builds the play from its own notch, so the edges stay parallel to the notch at every size. 48 px: notch 9 over 14, play 18 x 14 px with its flat side on x 18 (8 px of paper there, 7 at the tip), strap 4 px, 6.6 px above. 32 px: notch 6 over 9, play 12 x 9 px on x 12, strap 2.6 px. 16 px: the play is redrawn in whole pixels as columns of 6, 4, 4 and 2 on x 6, rows 4 to 9, resting on the tail with 2 px above and its lower steps 1 to 2 px from the notch. Glyph: notch 5 over 8, play 10 x 8 px on x 8, strap 3 px. Every cut keeps the play.
risks: The crisp corners follow the tail tips, so they are much crisper than the round shoulders, and some will read them as sharp. The play sits below the middle on purpose, which out of context can look as if it has slipped. At launcher sizes the difference from p1 is subtle (narrower, crisper, lower), and the notch rhyme is only visible from about 48 px up. Google Play Books pairs the same two symbols; the bookmark silhouette and the hole keep them apart.
